description:
Current award conditions

For 2027/28, up to 26 scholarships are advertised for eligible non-EU/non-EEA applicants. Tuition is reduced to EUR 2,771, with that amount still subject to confirmation. Living costs are not covered. Initial applications close on 31 January 2027 at 23:59 CET; the complete corrected application is due by 14 February 2027 at 23:59 CET.

Programme Overview

The Radboud Scholarship Programme 2027 is a partial scholarship for international students pursuing an English-taught Master's degree at Radboud University, Nijmegen, Netherlands. This is not a fully funded scholarship. Radboud explicitly describes it as a partial scholarship.

Financial Coverage

  • Tuition reduced from institutional rate (approximately €19,000) to €2,771.
  • Visa and residence permit covered.
  • Health and liability insurance (Aon Student Insurance) covered.
  • Living and study costs are NOT covered and must be borne by the student.
  • For 2-year Master's: renewal for second year only if all first-year courses are passed.
  • Can be combined with NL Scholarship.

Scholarship Allocation for 2027/28 (Maximum 26)

Eligibility Criteria

  • Non-EU/non-EEA passport holder and ineligible for EU/EEA reduced fee.
  • Bachelor's degree obtained outside the Netherlands. No prior degree or education in the Netherlands (exchange programme components are allowed).
  • Meet English language proficiency requirements for the Master's programme.
  • Full admission to an English-taught Master's programme starting 1 September 2027.
  • All English-taught Master's programmes are eligible. Exception: Erasmus Mundus and joint-degree programmes.

About Radboud University

Radboud University is a research university in Nijmegen, the Netherlands. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across science, medicine, law, management, humanities and social sciences. Its academic community supports research and teaching across disciplines, with work examining topics such as health, language, society and technology through international scholarly collaboration.

Official website: https://www.ru.nl

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Submit deadline31 January 2027, 23:59 CET
Complete deadline14 February 2027, 23:59 CET
DecisionBefore mid-April 2027

Application Process

  1. Apply for Master's admission through OSIRIS Application system.
  2. Indicate interest in the Radboud Scholarship during the application.
  3. Upload 2 reference letters and CV (same documents used for admission can be reused).
  4. Submit by 31 January 2027.
  5. Complete all requirements by 14 February 2027.

Official Link

https://www.ru.nl/en/education/scholarships/radboud-scholarship-programme

Important Notes

  • This is a partial scholarship. Living costs are not covered.
  • Scholarship selection is separate from admission. Admission does not guarantee scholarship.
  • Maximum 26 scholarships available.

EMJM scholarship 2026: funding contributes up to €1,400 per month towards living costs for the duration of the programme.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 31 January 2027. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
